golden_armada.title: Golden Armada
golden_armada.description: The Golden Armada patrols the map
golden_armada.notes: avoids within range 24 of player-allied structures until 6 min. Avoids within range 12 of player-allied structures until 12 min. Unrestricted after that.

low_quality_minerals.title: Low-Quality Minerals
low_quality_minerals.description: Mineral resource patches have fewer minerals

conga_line.title: Meat Grinder
conga_line.description: Zerglings, marines, and/or zealots constantly spawn from 3 randomly-selected enemy buildings and attack your base
conga_line.notes: not present on the crucible, or any other mission that does not have an enemy town hall

ten_minutes_until_destruction.title: 10 Minutes Until Destruction
ten_minutes_until_destruction.description: After 10 minutes all enemies will attack your base

darkness.title: Darkness
darkness.description: Reduce the the vision range of all of your units by 3

siege_mode.title: Siege Mode
siege_mode.description: The enemy has sieged tanks scattered around the map
siege_mode.notes: 10 sieged tanks. None spawn within range 15 of a player or player-allied structure.

drakken_laser_drill_enemy.title: Drakken Laser Drill
drakken_laser_drill_enemy.description: The enemy has a Drakken Laser Drill
drakken_laser_drill_enemy.notes: Becomes operational 3 minutes after base established. "The Drakken Laser Drill is Operational" at that point. The player should always have vision of the laser drill once it arrives.

arms_race.title: Arms Race
arms_race.description: Enemy damage is increased by 10% every 2 minutes

dark_archons.title: Archons
dark_archons.notes: 10 archons on separate patrols. Start patrolling 2 minutes after base established. Patrol cannot take them within range 20 player or player-allied structures until 8 minutes. At that point they cannot get within range 10 until 12 minutes. After that they have no restrictions to their patrol path. Except on island maps, they always spawn in places pathable to the player base.

sniper_thor.title: Sniper Thor
sniper_thor.description: A thor with enhanced health, range, and damage is somewhere on the map
sniper_thor.notes: Does not patrol. triple to all listed stats. Located in an enemy-controlled area that isn't more than range 50 from the player base (or further range if no suitable location is found) but not within range 20 of player base. At 16 minutes after base established it attacks toward the player base.

tower_defense.title: Tower Defense
tower_defense.description: Hostile probes continually build photon cannons, shield batteries, and pylons around the map
tower_defense.notes: Spawn a new probe in a hostile-controlled area every 30 seconds and have it start trying to build anywhere, even in the player base

drop_pods.title: Drop Pods
drop_pods.description: Drop pods filled with terran infantry randomly drop around the map
drop_pods.notes: They can drop anywhere and then attack move towards the nearest player building every 40-80 seconds. 3-5 marines, 0-2 marauders or 0-3 firebats, 0-2 medics. First drop is 4 minutes after base established.

viking_raids.title: Viking Raids
viking_raids.description: Vikings periodically try to land in your mineral lines
viking_raids.notes: Every 20-180 seconds spawn 1-3 vikings in enemy territory to fly directly to a player mineral line and land. Every 2 minutes, increase the upper bound of number of vikings by 1 and every 3 minute increase the lower bound of number of vikings by 1, but also increase the lower bound of the viking spawn time by 3 seconds. First spawn is always 3 minutes after base established.

dark_templar.title: Dark Templar
dark_templar.notes: Every 60-160 seconds a group of 1-3 dark templar spawn in enemy territory and attack towards the player base. Increase the upper bound of how many dark templar can spawn by 1 every time they spawn, but increase the spawn cooldown by 10 seconds every time they spawn. First spawn is 5 minutes after base established.

squishy.title: Squishy
squishy.description: Your units have all 0 armor, even with upgrades
squishy.notes: cannot have with any blessings that give armor

picky_eaters.title: Picky Eaters
picky_eaters.description: Supply structures and bases provide far less supply
picky_eaters.notes: Supply depots, overlords, pylons, and main bases only provide 4 supply each. Include variants like overseers and enhanced supply depots

decay.title: Decay
decay.description: Each of your units gain one stack of decay every minute. For each stack of decay, a unit takes 1 damage every 10 seconds.

forced_variety.title: Forced Variety
forced_variety.description: Building a unit increases its cost for the rest of the mission
forced_variety.notes: Increase the mineral/gas cost of a unit by 2% every time it is successfully built

zombies_mutation.title: Zombies
zombies_mutation.description: Whenever any unit dies, they spawn a hostile infested terran
zombies_mutation.notes: all zombies attack towards the nearest player building every 20 seconds. Zombies do not spawn other zombies

jetpacks.title: Jetpacks
jetpacks.description: All enemy marines, zealots, and zerglings can fly and sometimes attack your base
jetpacks.notes: Eligible Marine/Zealot/Zergling variants use the Mutalisk-shell flying implementation, and Slay sends existing Jetpacked units in attack waves: 4:00≈50 minerals, 6:00≈100, +50/minute to a 1000 mineral cost cap; never spawn extra units for the wave, just send existing units on the battlefield.

limited_bank.title: Limited Bank
limited_bank.description: You cannot store more than 1700 total resources at a time
limited_bank.notes: Every few seconds just check if the total is more than 1700 between minerals and gas and reduce whichever one is greater until the sum is 1700

leviathan_in_orbit.title: Leviathan in Orbit
leviathan_in_orbit.description: Many zerg drop pods constantly rain down
leviathan_in_orbit.notes: Every 20 seconds spawn a zerg drop pod at a random location on the map and have them attack move towards the nearest player building every 20 seconds. Pods have 2-6 zerglings, 0-2 roaches or 0-2 hydralisks, and a 25% chance of having a queen. 50% of drop pods should specifically try to land on player units. Every minute, decrease the drop pod cooldown by 1 second to a minimum of 2 seconds. Drops start 4 minutes after base established.

heroes_of_the_storm.title: Heroes of the Storm
heroes_of_the_storm.description: Enemy heroes wander the map (Warning: some may be cloaked)
heroes_of_the_storm.notes: 3 + X random heroes in different locations on different random patrols where X is the mission layer. Start patrolling at 5 minutes but are not allowed within range 20 of a player or player-allied building until after 15 minutes at which point they can patrol anywhere on the map. They spawn in pathable locations to the player base except for island missions.

too_many_wraiths.title: Too many Wraiths
too_many_wraiths.description: Independent enemy wraiths attack from all sides
too_many_wraiths.notes: Starting 2 minutes after base established, every 10-60 seconds a wraith spawns on a random map edge and attacks towards the player. Gradually increase spawn rate until 13 minutes after base established when it should be a wraith every 2-10 seconds.

nuclear_annihilation.title: Nuclear Annihilation
nuclear_annihilation.description: Every 30 seconds, a nuke can land ANYWHERE
nuclear_annihilation.notes: Do the full animation for the nuke beginning to appear and such so the player has time to react.

void_thrashers.title: Void Thrashers
void_thrashers.description: Void Thrashers spawn to siege your base
void_thrashers.notes: Every 1.5 minutes spawn a void thrasher as close to the player base as possible without being within range 30. It shoots its long ranged shots at player buildings. First one doesn't spawn until 4 minutes after base established.

not_enough_energy.title: Energy Leak
not_enough_energy.description: Your units and structures all lose 1 energy every 3 seconds

occasional_thor_mutation.title: Occasional Thor
occasional_thor_mutation.description: Some enemy units are actually Thors
occasional_thor_mutation.notes: Every minute, one out of 80 enemy units are turned into a thor, prioritizing transforming zerglings, zealots, and marines. 6 minutes after a thor is created this way it is sent to attack the player.

occasional_ultralisk_mutation.title: Occasional Ultralisk
occasional_ultralisk_mutation.description: Some enemy units are actually Ultralisks
occasional_ultralisk_mutation.notes: Every minute, one out of 80 enemy units are turned into an ultralisk, prioritizing transforming zerglings, zealots, and marines. 6 minutes after an ultralisk is created this way it is sent to attack the player.

occasional_colossus_mutation.title: Occasional Colossus
occasional_colossus_mutation.description: Some enemy units are actually Colossi
occasional_colossus_mutation.notes: Every minute, one out of 80 enemy units are turned into a colossus, prioritizing transforming zerglings, zealots, and marines. 6 minutes after a colossus is created this way it is sent to attack the player.

enemy_regeneration.title: Enemy Regeneration
enemy_regeneration.description: Enemy units and structures all recover 5 life and shield per second

another_gorgon_mutation.title: ANOTHER GORGON
another_gorgon_mutation.description: The enemy sends many gorgons at you, but they are quite fragile
another_gorgon_mutation.notes: Make gorgons only have 100 hit points and spawn every 60 seconds. First one doesn't spawn until 3 minutes after base established.

burrowed_zerglings.title: Burrowed Zerglings
burrowed_zerglings.description: There are 150 burrowed zerglings scattered throughout the map
burrowed_zerglings.notes: Zerglings unburrow to attack you when you get near. They do not spawn in the player base.

miras_mercenaries.title: Mira's Mercenaries
miras_mercenaries.description: Mira Han has mercenaries on the map on the enemy team. If you have 6000 minerals you purchase them for yourself for this mission only.
miras_mercenaries.notes: They are automatically given to the player once they have 6000 minerals and the minerals are then removed. The mercenaries are 6 siege breakers, 10 spartan company, 20 war pigs, 10 hammer securities, 5 hel's angels, 5 devil dogs, 2 nightwings. Until given to the player, they are hostile to the player. Every minute, a random 2 of the mercenary units attack the player. They do not spawn near player buildings or player allies. First attack from them is 3 minutes after base established.

taldarim_reinforcements.title: Tal'darim Reinforcements
taldarim_reinforcements.description: Absurdly Deadly Tal'darim armies repeatedly attack after the 20 minute mark
taldarim_reinforcements.notes: Make a text chat appear saying "The Tal'Darim have arrived". Make it 20 minutes game time, not 20 minutes after establishing a base. In various enemy locations, spawn 1-4 tal'darim motherships, 25-35 supplicants, 15-20 slayers, 2-10 blood hunters, 2-10 ascendants, 5-15 havocs, 5-10 vanguards, 3-8 wrathwalkers, 5-10 destroyers, and alarak (only once). They all attack the player base. Spawn half as many units for the first wave, and then every 2 minutes spawn another wave that is 20% bigger up to the full amount.

no_deaths_allowed.title: No Deaths Allowed
no_deaths_allowed.description: Whenever one of your units die, spawn an enemy ultralisk with timed life in its place
no_deaths_allowed.notes: The ultralisks should have 10 seconds of timed life. Show timed life bars like for archon cannon mini archon boon. Only spawn for "real" units that the player can control. Do not spawn for deaths of larva, eggs, or units the player cannot control. Do spawn for workers and other combat units that the player can control.

victory_is_temporary.title: Victory is Temporary
victory_is_temporary.description: Enemy units have a 50% chance of respawning 1 minute after they die
victory_is_temporary.notes: They respawn in the same place where they died.

nuclear_workers.title: Nuclear Workers
nuclear_workers.description: Your workers set off a nuclear explosion when they die

double_time.title: Double Time
double_time.description: All units move and attack twice as fast.

shrinkage.title: Shrinkage
shrinkage.description: Your units continually shrink over time
shrinkage.notes: non-worker Player units lose 1% (additive) max hp, movement speed, attack damage, size, range, and speed every 6 seconds. Stacks up to 90 times. Affects units individually such that new units spawn with 0 stacks of shrinkage. By 90 stacks they should only have 10% of each of their stats.

mineral_thieves.title: Mineral Thieves
mineral_thieves.description: The enemy repeatedly calls down MULEs to steal your mineral fields
mineral_thieves.notes: 1 mule every 1-60 seconds. Reduce the maximum cooldown by 3s every minute of game time up to 1-2 seconds. Only called down on mineral fields that you have workers or a base somewhat nearby.

active_enemies.title: Active enemies
active_enemies.description: Enemies move around independently a lot more
active_enemies.notes: Give every enemy independently a new patrol route every 2-4 minutes, starting at minute 3 after base established. They should still have normal combat AI as they move around. They cannot patrol within range 15 of a player of player-allied building until 6 minutes after base established.

zagaras_banelings.title: Zagara's Banelings
zagaras_banelings.description: Every 10 minutes, zagara sends 100 banelings towards your base
zagaras_banelings.notes: First spawn at the 10 minute mark. Put a text notification "BANELINGS INCOMING" in the chat on baneling spawns. make sure the banelings attack both units and structures they pass by. They should spawn in a single large clump in the enemy base and attack towards the player base. Play voice campaigns\swarmstory.sc2campaign\enus.sc2assets\localizeddata\sounds\vo\zmission_char01_roguequeen_091.ogg on the first spawn, campaigns\swarmstory.sc2campaign\enus.sc2assets\localizeddata\sounds\vo\zmission_char01_roguequeen_056.ogg on second baneling wave and campaigns\swarmstory.sc2campaign\enus.sc2assets\localizeddata\sounds\vo\zmission_char01_roguequeen_057.ogg on third baneling wave. Do not play any animations with those voice lines.

buddy_system.title: Buddy System
buddy_system.description: Your units rapidly take damage when not near an ally
buddy_system.notes: Every second check each player unit and deal 50 dmg to them if they are more than range 7.5 from an ally. Structures count as allies. Wait until base established. Structures are not affected.

torrasque.title: Torrasque
torrasque.description: The Torrasque attacks your base. Every time you kill him he gets stronger
torrasque.notes: He respawns 5 seconds after death in enemy territory (not within range 20 of any player unit, otherwise his spawn waits). First attack is 4 minutes after base established. Use a buffed ultralisk with +100% hp, +25% size, +25% damage, +2 armor. Every time he dies, he gains an additional (additive) 8% hp, 1% size, 2% damage.

raynors_raiders.title: Raynor's Raiders
raynors_raiders.description: The Hyperion regularly flies by your base along with many of Raynor's reinforcements
raynors_raiders.notes: Hyperion flies to a random one of 5 nearest player buildings, drops a bunch of terran drop pods, then retreats to a different/random deep enemy safe point each time. Repair pods occasionally drop while stopped in safe territory 1 SCV each. SCVs use the repair command on the hyperion (make sure they can afford it), or if repair is bugged then hyperion should just gain a passive regen while at least 1 scv is near. Raynor's first flyby should be 6.5 minutes after base established and then as soon as full hp or after 3 minutes have passed every time after that.

purifier.title: Purifier
purifier.description: The purifier with a golden armada escort slowly approaches your base
purifier.notes: The purifier starts on the opposite side of the map and slowly starts approaching your base 2 minutes after base established. Starting 2 minutes after base established, its warp-in cooldowns begin. Every 50 seconds it warps in (warp in animation) a scout, phoenix, void ray, or carrier to stay near it and protect it. Every 2 minutes 5 zealots and 5 stalkers warp in underneath it (Warp in animation) and attack towards the player base. Once the purifier is over your main base it fires its planet cracker purification beam. Warp in each zealot and stalker 1 at a time rapidly over the course of 2 seconds to make it look cooler. When the purifier reaches 50% hp, it warps in 4 void rays.

nexus_shield.title: Nexus Shield
nexus_shield.description: The enemy has a special nexus somewhere. All enemy units have 300 shields until it is destroyed.
nexus_shield.notes: increase their shields by 300 rather than setting it to account for units that already have shields. nexus is in an enemy base area and cannot spawn near a player-controlled or player-allied building

gargantuan_enemies.title: Gargantuan Enemies
gargantuan_enemies.description: Enemy units are gargantuan and have 50% more health, damage, size, and range

dehakas_pack.title: Dehaka's Pack
dehakas_pack.description: Dehaka and swarms of primal zerg constantly attack your base
dehakas_pack.notes: 4 minutes after base established, every 20 seconds send 0-8 primal lings, 0-2 primal hydras, 0-2 primal roaches, 0-2 primal mutas, 0-1 primal ultralisk. Spawn at different enemy-controlled locations and each unit individually attacks towards a different player building, finding a new random target every 30 seconds. 7 minutes after base established improve the spawn rate to every 12 seconds, after 10 minutes improve to 8 seconds, and after 13 minutes improve to every 6 seconds. Also, starting at 6 minutes after base established, once every 3 minutes spawn dehaka if he isn't already alive and have him follow the same attack pattern. For the ultralisk category, make it a 75% chance of spawning 0. Dehaka should be visible to the player always

zombie_apocalypse.title: Zombie Apocalypse
zombie_apocalypse.description: Every unit that dies spawns multiple infested terran that attack your base
zombie_apocalypse.notes: Obviously infested terran do not spawn more on death. They spawn from player and enemy units, but not from the deaths of larva, eggs, or broodlings. They always spawn 1-3 melee infested terran (like the other zombies mutation), but also a 20% chance of spawning an additional gun infested terran (like what infestors spawn). All spawned infested terran are enemies to the player.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Your units occasionally get in arguments and fight each other
arguments.notes: Every 20-60 seconds, choose one player unit. Have it attack command against another player unit (not attack move towards, but actually attack the unit directly). The player still technically controls it so if they react fast they can get it to stop.

combat_pay.title: Combat Pay
combat_pay.description: You lose 4 minerals every time you kill an enemy unit

nuclear_structures.title: Nuclear Structures
nuclear_structures.description: Enemy structures detonate in a nuclear explosion on death

resource_swap.title: Resource Swap
resource_swap.description: When you obtain vespene gas, obtain minerals instead. when you obtain minerals, obtain vespene gas instead.
resource_swap.notes: Also make sure to swap starting resources. If dynamically swapping all sources of income is too difficult then we can change this to only swap vespene geysers and mineral fields to provide the opposite resource type.

marauder_kill_teams.title: Marauder Kill Teams
marauder_kill_teams.description: After 5 minutes, 2 Marauder Kill Teams begin patrolling the map
marauder_kill_teams.notes: Play the 2 relevant horner voice lines and mark them on your map. Use the actual kill team marauders and medics. Spawn 15 marauders and 3 medics in each kill team. The patrols should patrol between several random non-player-controlled points around the map (or controlled by player allies). If they happen to walk through the player base then that is allowed, but the actual patrol points should be enemy or neutral areas. They should spawn in enemy territory 5 minutes after base established. Note that marauders in marauder kill teams should have +4 damage and +2 armor from normal marauders. They are not allowed within range 15 of a player or player-allied building until the 12 minute mark at which point they can patrol anywhere on the map.

hellion_run_by.title: Hellion Run-by
hellion_run_by.description: Hellions try to run into your mineral lines
hellion_run_by.notes: Every 45 seconds after 4 minutes have passed after base established, 1 hellion spawns in enemy territory to move directly into a random player-controlled mineral line. Increase the number of hellions by 1 every time they spawn and increase the spawn cooldown by 4 seconds each time they spawn as well (so it gets slower over time). Does not appear on island missions.

diamondback_wanderers.title: Diamondbacks
diamondback_wanderers.description: 50 diamondbacks wander all over the place
diamondback_wanderers.notes: starting 60 seconds after base established, choose 3 diamondbacks every second to give it a move command to a random part of the map. Rotate through the diamondbacks so they all get commands on repeat until dead or until the end of the mission. They should have 90% chance of moving to an enemy-base area and 10% chance of moving to any pathable area (including player base areas). Every minute, change the percentage that could go to any pathable area by 5%.

leviathan_outside_base.title: Leviathan Approaching
leviathan_outside_base.description: The Leviathan floats outside your base spawning mutalisks and brood lords
leviathan_outside_base.notes: Use WoL leviathan. It starts in enemy territory after base established. 5 minutes after base established it should fly towards the player base until it is within range 30 of a player-controlled building. It should then spawn 1 mutalisk every 30 seconds and 1 brood lord every 55 seconds that attack towards the player base. It should gradually increase spawn rate until the 20 minute mark when it should spawn 1 mutalisk every 2 seconds and 1 brood lord every 4.5 seconds. Use the leviathan's actual "spawn mutalisk" and "spawn broodlord" abilities. It should be visible on the map. When the leviathan first takes damage, it should instantly use its mutalisk ability an extra time. Once it reaches below half hp it should rapidly use its mutalisk ability 20 times over the next 4 seconds. Reduce the leviathan's movement speed to 0.5.

odin.title: Odin
odin.description: The enemy base has an odin in it. After about 14 minutes it attacks your base.
odin.notes: It should use its special cannons ability. This mutation should not be on island maps. It spawns 14 minutes after base established

combined_raids.title: Ultimate Harassment
combined_raids.description: The enemy sends many wraiths, vikings, and hellions bother you
combined_raids.notes: combine the effects of "viking raids" "too many wraiths" and "hellion run-by". It should stack with any of those mutations.

brakk_primal_army.title: Brakk's Pack
brakk_primal_army.description: Brakk and a massive primal army awaits on the map. It attacks after about 11 minutes.
brakk_primal_army.notes: Have brakk in enemy territory along with 20 primal mutalisks, 40 primal zerglings, 10 primal guardians, 20 primal hydralisks, 20 primal roaches, and 10 primal ultralisks. They attack the player base 11 minutes after base established. Not available on island maps.

orlan_fortress.title: Orlan's Planetary Fortress
orlan_fortress.description: Colonel Orlan has a well-defended Planetary Fortress on the map that gains 1 range every 30 seconds.
orlan_fortress.notes: The planetary has Jackson's Revenge right above it and 3 sieged siegebreakers near it, and 3 missile turrets near it. Also spawn 20 scvs in a circle around it that should move command towards it to fully surround it and then try to repair it whenever it is damaged. The planetary should spawn more than range 40 from the player-controlled or player-allied buildings but less than 60. It should be visible to the player and it should be within the boundries of the map and pathable to the player base unless it is an island map. Not available on defense missions.

enemy_spear_of_adun.title: Enemy Spear of Adun
enemy_spear_of_adun.description: The enemy has the Spear of Adun. Let's see how YOU like it
enemy_spear_of_adun.notes: passives: guardian shell. Normal Actives: orbital strike, shield overcharge, solar lance, temporal field, deploy fenix. Special actives: Purifier beam, solar bombardment, time stop. Every 30 seconds the spear of adun should try to use a random one of its normal actives. Every 3 minutes it should instead try to use one of its special actives.

true_golden_armada.title: True Golden Armada
true_golden_armada.description: An absurdely massive golden armada patrols the map
true_golden_armada.notes: Same logic as the normal golden armada mutation (including the logic that prevents it from attacking the player base early) but make it 10 carriers, 1 mothership (normal multiplayer mothership), 15 void rays, 10 tempests, and 20 phoenix (have the phoenix move in a circle around the golden armada, never needing to attack move since they attack while moving), and 3 oracles (they are just to cast revelation on any cloaked units, script them to do that). Make sure the mothership is always visible to the player. Once the mothership dies, just have the remaining golden armada attack towards the player base using our normal AI for that. avoids getting within range 40 of player-allied buildings until 10 min. range 30 until 15 min, range 20 until 20 min, and then no range limit after 20 min.

immortal_zergling.title: Immortal Zergling
immortal_zergling.description: A single immortal zergling attacks you constantly
immortal_zergling.notes: This zergling should be untargetable, invulnerablle, and should spawn in the enemy base in a pathable area to attack towards the player 3 minutes after base established. It should use simple attack moves towards a random enemy unit that refreshes every minute.

tosh_and_his_boys.title: Tosh and his Boys
tosh_and_his_boys.description: Tosh is somewhere on the map. While he lives, cloaked spectres periodically try to nuke your base.
tosh_and_his_boys.notes: Tosh spawns in enemy territory and patrols between enemy territories with normal attack and ability ai. He starts patrolling at 4 minutes after base established. Starting 5 minutes after base established the first spectre spawns in enemy territory and uses his calldown nuke ability on a random location within range 5 of the nearest player buliding. Another spectre spawns every minute as long as tosh is alive. Tosh and spectres spawn in pathable locations to the player base and this mutation is not available on island maps. His patrol cannot take him within range 30 of a player or player-allied building.

nydus_worms.title: Nydus Worms
nydus_worms.description: Nydus worms periodically spawn throughout the map to send units towards your base
nydus_worms.notes: The nydus worms should do the full reveal animation, not simply spawn. If they are spawning through normal means they should make the sound like they do when they appear in the campaign. They should always appear in pathable locations from the player base otherwise they wait to spawn until a pathable location is available. First appears at 4 minutes. They then spawn on 40-50 second cooldowns. 10 seconds after spawning, they release 0-6 zerglings, 0-1 banelings, 0-2 hydralisks or 0-2 roaches, and a 25% chance of releasing a queen. They should release units again every minute until slain. The first spawn should be within range 4-25 of a player or player-allied structure, then increase the upper-bound range limit by 5 with each spawn, but they must always spawn on the map. The player should always have vision of the nydus worms until slain. When they spawn units, they should spawn a stream of 3 units per second (spread out over the second) rather than instantly spawning all at once.

point_defense_drones.title: Point Defense Drones
point_defense_drones.description: Enemy structures each have a point defense drone deployed near them to stop your projectiles
point_defense_drones.notes: Spawn a point defense drone (the unit spawned from the raven ability) next to each enemy building. They should not have timed life like the normal raven point defense drones.

heavily_defended_drakken_laser_drill.title: Heavily-Defended Drakken Laser Drill
heavily_defended_drakken_laser_drill.description: The enemy has a Heavily-Defended Drakken Laser Drill
heavily_defended_drakken_laser_drill.notes: Same logic as normal drakken laser drill mutation except it starts with 5 siege breakers and 5 missile turrets around it.

multiple_air_bogies.title: Multiple Air Bogies
multiple_air_bogies.description: Zerg air units occasionally attack your base
multiple_air_bogies.notes: Starts at 5 minutes after base established and repeats every 2 minutes after that. Spawn them at a random map edge at least range 10 from any player or player-allied building. Increase the time between spawns by 10 seconds every time they spawn and every time they spawn add in 1 mutalisk. Every minute after the 10 minute mark, have a 25% chance of adding a broodlord to the spawns. First spawn has 3 mutalisks.

hybrid_research.title: Hybrid Research
hybrid_research.description: Each enemy structure releases a random hybrid when destroyed
hybrid_research.notes: 40% chance of hybrid reaver, 40% of hybrid destroyer, 10% of hybrid nemesis, 5% of hybrid behemoth, and 5% of hybrid dominator

fifty_immortals.title: Immortals
fifty_immortals.description: There are 30 immortals patrolling around the map

multi_class.title: Multi-Class
multi_class.description: You start with an additional scv, drone, and probe

power_overwhelming.title: Power Overwhelming
power_overwhelming.description: Your workers can merge into archons

drakken_laser_drill_blessing.title: Drakken Laser Drill
drakken_laser_drill_blessing.description: Workers can construct a Drakken Laser Drill for 800 minerals and gas

juggernaut.title: Juggernaut
juggernaut.description: Your units gain armor equal to their supply cost but move 15% slower

explosive_armor.title: Explosive Armor
explosive_armor.description: Your units explode on death, dealing damage to enemies proportional to their supply cost
explosive_armor.notes: baneling-sized explosion. 20x their supply cost damage. Increase explosion radius by 1 per supply cost greater than 1.

assembly_line.title: Assembly Line
assembly_line.notes: includes units, upgrades, and building structures.

general.title: (hero) Commander
general.description: You gain (hero). They do not respawn.
general.notes: spawns once you get a base set up. Respawn at player base 60 seconds after death. Say the hero name in the description and title. Do not include tychus in this blessing.

air_support.title: Air Support
air_support.description: Random allied aircraft spawn to attack the enemies, but you cannot control them
air_support.notes: Every minute, spawn one random allied aircraft and have it attack towards enemies using normal AI behaviors. Choose from scout, void ray, battlecruiser, carrier, tempest, banshee, brood lord, guardian, mutalisk, raven (starting with maximum energy, controlled using our unit AI), and mothership (not taldarim variant). Player cannot control it.

fire_squad.title: Fire Squad
fire_squad.description: Start with a squad of fiery units
fire_squad.notes: Start with 3 firebats, 2 hellions, and 2 helbats, 1 colossus (purifier variant so it has the fire beam)

rapid_evolution.title: Constant Evolution
rapid_evolution.description: Your units gain 1 maximum HP every 5 seconds

zombies_blessing.title: Zombies
zombies_blessing.description: Whenever any unit dies, they spawn an allied infested terran
zombies_blessing.notes: players cannot control zombies and they attack towards the nearest enemy building. Zombies do not spawn other zombies

compounding_interest.title: Compound Interest
compounding_interest.description: Increase your mineral supply by 10% every 30 seconds.
compounding_interest.notes: only starts after you have a base

transports.title: Transports
transports.notes: start with a hercules dropship with 1000 hp, a dopperlord, warpprism, and medivac each with 500 hp

blink_blessing.title: Blink
blink_blessing.description: All of your units have the blink ability

lost_vikings.title: Lost Vikings
lost_vikings.description: Every 60 seconds, gain a viking in a random location
lost_vikings.notes: Viking spawns under player control in the air in a completely random location, even the enemy base

warfields_reinforcements.title: Warfield's Reinforcements
warfields_reinforcements.description: Warfield sends many allied drop pods to aid you in random locations
warfields_reinforcements.notes: completely random, even enemy base. Every 30 seconds send 2 drop pods in random locations. Player cannot control them, they just attack move towards enemy structures. 1-4 marines, 0-1 medic, 0-1 marauder or 0-3 firebats. Occasionally sends "tactical squad omega" which has ghosts

instant_workers.title: Instant workers
instant_workers.notes: Or take 0.1 seconds to build, whatever is easiest to implement

horde_mode.title: Horde Mode
horde_mode.description: Your units cost half as much, build twice as fast, and have 25% fewer hit points
horde_mode.notes: also have them use up half as much supply and be half the size

elite_soldiers.title: Elite Soldiers
elite_soldiers.description: Your trained units and structures have a 15% increase to all of their stats
elite_soldiers.notes: Stats include health, shields armor (if possible with fractions), speed, damage, attack speed, regeneration, maximum energy, energy regeneration. Only affects trained units and not units that were spawned in for free.

occasional_thor_blessing.title: Occasional Thor
occasional_thor_blessing.description: Whenever you train a unit, you have a 4% chance of training a Thor instead

occasional_ultralisk_blessing.title: Occasional Ultralisk
occasional_ultralisk_blessing.description: Whenever you train a unit, you have a 4% chance of training an Ultralisk instead

occasional_colossus_blessing.title: Occasional Colossus
occasional_colossus_blessing.description: Whenever you train a unit, you have a 4% chance of training a Colossus instead

blinding_light.title: Blinding Light
blinding_light.description: Reduce the vision range of enemies by 4

specialists.title: Specialists
specialists.description: Start with a wide variety of spellcasters
specialists.notes: Start with a ghost, raven, science vessel, infestor, defiler, spectre, viper, high templar, sentry, and oracle

baneling_stream.title: Baneling Stream
baneling_stream.description: Your main bases all spawn banelings that automatically attack the enemy base
baneling_stream.notes: Each nexus, hatchery, command center, etc. spawns 1 baneling every 5-15 seconds outside of your control that attacks towards the enemy.

tychus.title: Tychus
tychus.description: You can technically control tychus, but he is automatically issued an attack move order towards the enemy every 10-25 seconds.
tychus.notes: You can technically control tychus, but he is automatically issued an attack move order towards the enemy every 10-25 seconds.

unexpected_evolution.title: Unexpected Evolution
unexpected_evolution.description: When you train a unit, there is a chance to actually train a more expensive unit.
unexpected_evolution.notes: 20% chance to find a completely random unit that costs more than what you trained and train that instead

another_gorgon_blessing.title: ANOTHER GORGON
another_gorgon_blessing.description: Warfield is sending gorgon after gorgon to assist you, but they are quite fragile
another_gorgon_blessing.notes: Make gorgons only have 100 hit points and spawn every 60 seconds not under your control attacking towards the enemy. Bonus points if you get warfield to play a random one of his "send in another gorgon" or "ANOTHER GORGON" voice lines every time he spawns one or one dies.

zagaras_aid.title: Zagara's Aid
zagaras_aid.description: Every 10 minutes Zagara sends 100 banelings to aid you.
zagaras_aid.notes: Banelings spawn on your main base and you can control them.

stealth_tunnels.title: Stealth Tunnels
stealth_tunnels.description: All of your units can move while burrowed
stealth_tunnels.notes: Only have this mutation on zerg missions

lurker_defense.title: Lurker Defense
lurker_defense.description: You start with 4 lurkers and 4 impalers to protect your base, but they move slowly
lurker_defense.notes: Make them have only 50% movement speed.

building_overcharge.title: Building Turrets
building_overcharge.description: All of your buildings shoot lasers
building_overcharge.notes: Give every player building a weapon. Does not work on spider mines even though they are technically buildings.

combat_workers.title: Combat Workers
combat_workers.description: Your workers have triple health, damage, speed, and attack speed
combat_workers.notes: Also make sure to triple the shields on probes.

glass_cannons.title: Glass Cannons
glass_cannons.description: Your units deal double damage but have 35% less health

ghost_reporting.title: Ghost Reporting
ghost_reporting.description: You start with 3 ghosts and a ghost academy with unlimited nukes

bounty_kills.title: Bounty Kills
bounty_kills.description: You gain 4 minerals and 2 gas every time you kill an enemy unit

glorious_martyrs.title: Glorious Martyrs
glorious_martyrs.description: whenever one of your units die, all nearby units gain a permanent speed and attack speed bonus
glorious_martyrs.notes: Affects units within range 4, permanent 5% increase to movement speed and 10% to attack speed, stacks indefinitely additively

inflatable_soldiers.title: Inflatable Soldiers
inflatable_soldiers.description: Your non-worker units continually grow in all ways but become become slower over time
inflatable_soldiers.notes: all your non-worker and non-building units grow every 12 seconds, gaining +25% attack damage, +15% health and +0.1 attack range every 6 seconds, but loses 4.5% movement speed with each stack. The unit becomes immobile after the 20th stack. Attack speed no longer decays after the 10th stack, but the damage bonus will be halved for every stack after the 10th. Stacks up to 300 times.

infinite_larva.title: Infinite Larva
infinite_larva.description: Your bases produce nearly unlimited larva
infinite_larva.notes: Maximum of 20 larva, produce larva almost instantly. Only available on zerg missions.

reflective_armor.title: Reflective Armor
reflective_armor.description: Your units reflect 50% of incoming damage back to attackers

rich_vespene.title: Rich Vespene
rich_vespene.description: All vespene geysers are replaced with rich vespene geysers

rich_minerals.title: Rich Minerals
rich_minerals.description: All mineral fields are replaced with rich mineral fields

resource_pickups.title: Resource Pickups
resource_pickups.description: mineral and gas resource pickups scattered around the map
resource_pickups.notes: 50 pickups available total. Each gives 50 minerals or gas.

covert_assistance.title: Covert Assistance
covert_assistance.description: Tosh works independently to assist you. He does not respawn.
covert_assistance.notes: Tosh spawns at the 1 minute mark and is AI controlled to attack the enemy and use his abilities. The player cannot control him and he uses normal AI to attack the enemy but if he drops below 50% hp he uses his defense matrix ability and moves straight back to the player base until full health. He has 0.5 life regen per second.
